text:
maya (support): anyone else seeing a spike of 502/504s on hostedapi in eu1? getting 3 customer escalations in the last 20m, mostly streaming + large embed batches

hannah (customer-sre): customer repro steps attached, they hit 502s after ~8-12s when streaming with large batches (size=50). sending sample curl below.

hannah (customer-sre): ```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"...","batch_size":50,"stream":true}' \
  https://api.hosted.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```

jorge (eng-sre): looking at metrics — frontdoor/ingress eu1 shows 502/504s spike 12:58-13:25 UTC. traces point to upstream resets from nginx/envoy. grabbing sample logs now.

jorge (eng-sre): ```text
[envoy] upstream reset: connection failure, upstream_reset_reason=CONNECT_FAILURE upstream_host=10.2.4.12:443 trace_id=abc123
[nginx] 502 while reading response header from upstream, client=10.3.5.6 request_id=rid-9876
```

rachel (infra): I rolled out an nginx tweak at 12:55 UTC to reduce keepalive_timeout 75s->15s to free idle sockets during a different load class. that would cut long-lived streaming connections early. tagging @tom for rollback.

tom (prod-ops): agreed — initiating rollback to previous keepalive. starting deploy now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollback/nginx-keepalive-rollback -> target=eu1
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: rollback/nginx-keepalive-rollback -> status=success, finished_at=13:44:12 UTC

jorge (eng-sre): after rollback (13:44) 502 rate dropped ~80% within 5m. strong correlation to keepalive change. still seeing tail 504s that map to auth service latency spikes — auth cache TTL was lowered earlier this week.

li (devex): customers using chunked transfer / long streams are more sensitive to keepalive. suggested short-term workarounds: reduce batch_size (50->10) or route that tenant to dedicated instance while we stabilize.

maya (support): sent the customer both workarounds and asked for request ids/traces. they returned three trace ids: rid-9876, rid-9882, rid-9921 and a HAR link.

hannah (customer-sre): HAR link: https://files.redwood.ai/hannah/streams/har-12345 (contains sample request and timings)

jorge (eng-sre): proposed action items:
- revert keepalive to 75s (done)
- increase upstream connection pool for auth (pending infra change)
- add tighter retry/fallback policy for streaming requests to avoid multi-fanout retries

rachel (infra): increased auth upstream conn pool size from 50 -> 200 on eu1 at 13:55 UTC. watching for connection exhaustion metrics.

tom (prod-ops): monitoring dashboards show error rate near baseline after the two config changes. if it regresses we'll open an incident and capture nginx pprof + full envoy traces.

jorge (eng-sre): notes for postmortem: config change reduced keepalive dramatically which dropped long-lived streaming sessions -> upstream connection churn -> envoy/nginx upstream resets -> 502/504s. auth cache TTL + pool sizing exacerbated tail 504s.

maya (support): customer confirmed error reduction after rollback + pool bump. closing customer ticket but leaving thread for follow-ups and PM/infra review. :thumbsup:

li (devex): follow-up doc: add a short KB for customers on best practices for streaming & batching (recommended keepalive expectations, batch sizing, and retry policies). I'll draft it.

maya (support): thanks everyone. good job catching the correlation quickly.
